text_block_list.text: Is Uva not to your liking?
text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen

text_block_list.text:
Huh?! N-No,
it's very… deli… sicious…? More importantly,
um…
text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O

text_block_list.text:
Ah, that's right.
Let us settle the matter at hand. Please,
raise your head and follow me.
text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen

text_block_list.text:
I will be frank with you. Ardan-san,
despite her fragile constitution,
is an unmistakable prodigy of the Mejiro
family—
one of whom we are deeply proud of.
text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen

text_block_list.text:
Without wasting even a second in her pursuit
of excellence,
she expends patience and perseverance for
the sake of reaching her ideals.
text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen

text_block_list.text:
…And, she's very kind. When I, too,
was sickly as a child,
she taught me the basics of dancing.
text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen

text_block_list.text: …Huh? Your teacher… was… Ardan-san?
text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O

text_block_list.text:
Indeed.
She taught me that dance is a good foundation
to heighten your awareness of how your body's
muscles are moving.
text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen

text_block_list.text:
As an Umamusume of the Mejiro family,
she was a respected older sister figure from
whom I received instruction.
text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen

text_block_list.text: Is… that… so…
text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O

text_block_list.text:
…Ah, ahaha… She's incredible.
I knew it—
she's really… special… isn't she?
text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O

text_block_list.text:
Pray tell, why do you hang your head,
Chiyono O-san?
text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen

text_block_list.text:
…Uh, that's because… I'm just "ordinary,"
you see,
so… It feels like I'm on a totally different
planet from "special" Umamusume…
text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O

text_block_list.text:
Even if you were to believe that,
Ardan-san chose you.
text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen

text_block_list.text:
She thinks of you alone as her special
date.
text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen

text_block_list.text: (She thinks I'm… special…?)
text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O

text_block_list.text:
There is a saying in the Mejiro family that
even a sole event at the academy is enough
to fuel the fire in our hearts.
text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen

text_block_list.text:
For my Dorowa date,
I'd chosen a suitable partner who would
allow me the best opportunity to grow.
text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen

text_block_list.text:
I'm sure Ardan-san did the same.
Considering how much of a time commitment
it is,
I'm certain she carefully deliberated on
who she thought to be a worthy date.
text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen

text_block_list.text:
She would never take your hand with
half-hearted feelings.
text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen

text_block_list.text: …But I'm—
text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O

text_block_list.text:
If, despite all of that,
you still wish to seek for the reason you
believe yourself to be "ordinary",
then no matter. Please, feel free.
text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen

text_block_list.text:
However,
since Ardan-san has already found a reason
to believe you "special",
it may be a tad too late for that, no?
text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen

text_block_list.text:
Besides,
don't you think Ardan-san already treats
you as "special"?
text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen

text_block_list.text: …No, Ardan-san…
text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O

text_block_list.text:
Ardan-san never once… dismissed my lofty
goal of winning Best Date.
text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O

text_block_list.text:
Indeed. Because if it's with you,
she believes it to be possible.
text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen

text_block_list.text:
Even though she saw how I couldn't dance,
she even went on to say that you and Teio
would be our rivals.
text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O

text_block_list.text:
I'm sure Ardan-san believed your strength
was equal to,
or even greater than that of ours.
text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen

text_block_list.text:
…Oh, Ardan-san…! 
…Sorry, I have to go!
text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O

text_block_list.text:
Good day to you, Chiyono O-san. 
…And with that…
text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen

text_block_list.text:
Teio-san,
just why are you hiding?
I must say that I'm not pleased by your
peeking.
text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen

text_block_list.text:
Man… I was just thinking,
'you and I really are alike!'… Chiyono O's
surprisingly got a lotta fight in her,
huh?
text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio

text_block_list.text:
No matter how many times she falls down,
she always gets right back on her feet.
And when that happens,
she starts plannin' her next move.
text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio

text_block_list.text:
…Indeed.
Who on earth could think of a girl like that
as mediocre?
That in itself is her very talent.
text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen

text_block_list.text:
When she shows that side of her,
it makes you start thinking,
"I'm not gonna lose either!" huh?
text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
Tokai Teio
Mejiro McQueen

text_block_list.text:
For it is the presence of rivals that make
us stronger.
text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen

text_block_list.text:
For real! Plus,
I wouldn't be satisfied with just taking
first place.
Let's make history with a record-breaking
dance, McQueen!
text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio

text_block_list.text: Hah… hah… gh, hah…!
text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O

text_block_list.text:
(… Ardan-san… just what makes you believe
in my strength?)
text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O

text_block_list.text:
(Is… the answer I've finally reached… the
same as yours? I'm just a regular,
ordinary Umamusume, but… even, even so…!)
text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O

text_block_list.text:
Ardan-san! I… 
I—!
text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
